newsitem.title: CANADA: Morrison to net C$180 from trust unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Morrison to net C$180 from trust unit sale.

text.p: Morrison Petroleums Ltd said on Friday it priced its Morrison Facilities Income Fund units at C$10.10 each in an offering expected to result in net proceeds to the company of C$180 million.

A final prospectus for the issue, which would fetch gross proceeds of C$200 million, was being filed with regulators all Canadian provinces and it was anticipated that the offering would close on January 28, Morrison said.
When the offering closes, a company wholly owned by the fund will acquire from Morrison the Nevis Gas Plant and a crude oil pipeline in northeast British Columbia.
Unitholders are to receive quarterly cash distributions, starting on June 30, the company said.
Morrison said it intended to use the net proceeds to reduce long-term debt.
